home.metaTitle: Axessio — Digital accessibility audit SaaS platform
home.metaDescription: Centralize your digital accessibility audits (RGAA, WCAG, RAWeb, RAAM). Conformity tracking, non-conformity management, PDF reports — for auditors and client teams.

hero.title: Run RGAA & WCAG audits without spreadsheets.
hero.subtitle: Axessio centralizes your digital accessibility audits: conformity grid, traceable non-conformities, ready-to-deliver PDF reports — for auditors and client teams.

features.title: Everything for an accessibility audit, in one place
features.subtitle: From sample creation to report delivery, without copy-pasting between Excel, Word and email.

matrix.title: Conformity matrix
matrix.desc: Score each criterion page by page — compliant, non-compliant or not applicable — with automatic official score computation.

ncs.title: Tracked non-conformities
ncs.desc: Severity, recommendation, screenshots, discussion with the client: each NC lives in a structured thread, never lost in an email.

reports.title: Bilingual PDF reports
reports.desc: Ready-to-deliver PDF export, in French or English, with cover page, summary, page-by-page detail and NC fiches.

multitenant.title: Secure multi-tenant
multitenant.desc: Strict data isolation between clients (PostgreSQL Row Level Security). Auditors, client admins and members — everyone sees what they should.

i18n.title: FR / EN interface
i18n.desc: Switch French to English with one click — useful for international teams and clients outside Europe.

a11y.title: Accessible by design
a11y.desc: The tool used to audit accessibility itself meets WCAG 2.2 AA — visible focus, verified contrasts, keyboard navigation, screen readers.

standards.title: Compatible with official standards
standards.subtitle: The reference frameworks recognized in France and Europe for digital accessibility.

cta.title: Ready to structure your audits?
cta.subtitle: Sign in to your Axessio workspace to resume your in-progress audits, or contact us to open an account.

items.a: Axessio supports RGAA 4.1.2, WCAG 2.2, RAWeb 1.0, RAAM 1.0 and EN 301 549, on both web and mobile platforms.

items.q: How is the conformity score computed?
items.a: The score uses the official formula: compliant ÷ (total − not applicable) × 100. Unevaluated criteria do not penalize the score.

items.q: Can I export the report in English?
items.a: Yes. Every PDF report can be generated in French or English, with labels, badges and metadata in the target language.

privacy.metaDescription: Axessio privacy policy: data collected, purposes, legal basis, retention, GDPR rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Axessio takes the protection of personal data seriously. This policy explains how your data is collected, used and protected under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act.

controller.title: Data controller
lines: The data controller is Axessio SAS, 10 rue de la République, 75011 Paris, France.
GDPR / DPO contact: privacy@axessio.app.

data.title: Data collected
lines: Identification data: last name, first name, email address, preferred language.
Usage data: last login date, activity log (audits created, NCs filed, messages exchanged).
Business data (entered by you): names of your clients and projects, audit content, screenshots attached to non-conformities.
Technical data: IP address at authentication time, Supabase and Vercel access logs for security purposes.

purposes.title: Purposes
lines: Deliver the service: account creation, authentication, access to your audits.
Collaboration: send transactional emails (invitation, message notification), display the discussion thread.
Security: abuse detection, access logging, fraud prevention.
Anonymized internal product-usage statistics (no personal data).

basis.title: Legal basis
lines: Performance of the service contract (GDPR article 6.1.b) for data strictly necessary to operate the platform.
Legitimate interest (GDPR article 6.1.f) for technical logs and security.
Legal obligation (GDPR article 6.1.c) for accounting retention.

retention.title: Retention period
lines: User account: as long as the account is active, then 30 days after deletion.
Audits and non-conformities: kept as long as the end client remains subscribed, then archived for 3 years.
Technical logs: 12 months maximum.
Billing data: 10 years (accounting obligation).

recipients.title: Recipients and subprocessors
lines: Your data is never sold or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
Technical subprocessors (hosting, email): Supabase (Singapore), Vercel (USA, certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework), Resend (USA).
Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) from the European Commission govern transfers outside the EU.

rights.title: Your rights
lines: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
• Right of access and copy
• Right of rectification
• Right to erasure
• Right to restriction of processing
• Right to portability
• Right to object
• Right to define post-mortem directives
To exercise these rights: privacy@axessio.app. We will respond within one month.

complaint.title: Complaint
lines: If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can file a complaint with the CNIL: 3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07, France — www.cnil.fr.

security.title: Security
lines: Your data is transmitted over HTTPS / TLS 1.2+.
Isolation between clients is enforced by PostgreSQL Row Level Security policies.
Passwords are hashed and salted by Supabase Auth.
No access is possible to another client's data, even by Axessio administrators (except documented support intervention).

cookies.metaDescription: Axessio cookie policy: we only use strictly necessary functional cookies. No tracker, no advertising.
cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: Axessio uses only cookies strictly necessary to operate the service. No advertising cookies, no third-party trackers, no behavioral analytics tools are deployed. Following the CNIL doctrine, these functional cookies do not require a consent banner.

items.name: axessio-auth
items.purpose: Stores your authentication session (logged-in user). If the token is large, it may be split into multiple cookies axessio-auth.0, axessio-auth.1, etc.

items.name: axessio-locale
items.purpose: Remembers your interface language (French or English).

items.name: theme (localStorage)
items.purpose: Remembers your appearance preference (light, dark, system). Stored in browser localStorage, never transmitted to the server.
items.duration: Persistent until you clear browser storage

noTracking.title: No trackers
lines: We do not use any cookie for audience measurement, advertising, social networks or behavioral personalization.
No third-party tool such as Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or Hotjar is integrated into the site.

disable.title: Disabling cookies
lines: You can clear or block cookies at any time through your browser settings.
Note: disabling session cookies will prevent you from signing in to Axessio.

contact.title: Contact
lines: For any question regarding cookies: privacy@axessio.app.
